What is CANDISEYE?

We’re a mini girl-group fan project inspired by the confidence, teamwork, and performance energy of KATSEYE — with our own candy-sweet name and personality. Every member adds something different, and together we make the magic.

This is our little home for member introductions, cute updates, music favorites, and all things CANDISEYE.
